questions.prompt: What is the Judgement of Paris?
questions.modelAnswer: Paris (Alexander) chooses the fairest among Hera, Athena and Aphrodite for the golden apple Eris threw; he picks Aphrodite, who promises him Helen — a cause of the Trojan War.
